title: 24-Month Equal-Payment Installment in the Desk Minimum (Crestline Credit Card)
content:
For the minimum the Crestline care desk takes on the latest Crestline Credit Card statement, an installment for the 24-month equal-payment plan is added to the minimum: when the account holds such a plan and its balance at closing is more than the fixed monthly payment, the fixed monthly payment is added to the minimum; when it holds one whose balance at closing is above zero but no more than the fixed monthly payment, that balance is added; otherwise nothing is added for the plan.

## Figures used

- **The equal-payment balance at closing** is the 24-month equal-payment plan's purchase amount less the payment allocations recorded for it and the merchandise credits on its ticket, with the allocations of payments made toward the latest statement added back.
- **The plan's fixed monthly payment** is the purchase amount repaid in 24 equal monthly payments at the product's 24-month equal-payment APR divided by twelve: the purchase amount multiplied by the monthly rate, divided by one less the reciprocal of one plus the monthly rate raised to the 24th power, rounded up to the cent.

| Product | 24-month equal-payment APR used |
|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | 7.99% |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 8.99% |
| any other product | 9.99% |

## Installment table

| 24-month plan on the account | Balance at closing compared with the fixed monthly payment | Added to the minimum |
|---|---|---|
| yes | more than it | the fixed monthly payment |
| yes | above zero, no more than it | that balance |
| yes | zero | nothing |
| no | — | nothing |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A 1,200.00 USD purchase on a 24-month plan at 9.99%: the monthly rate is 9.99 percent divided by twelve, 0.8325 percent; the level payment comes to 55.3684 USD, rounded up to 55.37 USD. With a balance at closing of 400.00 USD, 55.37 USD is added; with a balance at closing of 41.20 USD, 41.20 USD is added.
